blocks.html: This documentation provides a reference to the `createTaxRateRules` method. This belongs to the Tax Module.
You should only use this methods when implementing complex customizations. For common cases, check out [available workflows instead](/medusa-workflows-reference).
This method creates a tax rate rule.

types.name: data
types.description: The tax rate rule to be created.

children.name: reference
children.description:
The snake-case name of the data model that the tax rule references.
For example, `product`.

Learn more in [this guide](https://docs.medusajs.com/resources/commerce-modules/tax/tax-rates-and-rules#override-tax-rates-with-rules).

children.name: reference_id
children.description:
The ID of the record of the data model that the tax rule references.
For example, `prod_123`.

Learn more in [this guide](https://docs.medusajs.com/resources/commerce-modules/tax/tax-rates-and-rules#override-tax-rates-with-rules).

children.name: tax_rate_id
children.description: The associated tax rate's ID.

children.name: metadata
children.description: Holds custom data in key-value pairs.

children.name: created_by
children.description:
Who created the tax rate rule. For example, the ID of the
user that created it.

children.description: An instance of a transaction manager of type `TManager`, which is a typed parameter passed to the context to specify the type of the `transactionManager`.

children.description: A boolean value indicating whether nested transactions are enabled.

children.description: A string indicating the idempotencyKey of the parent workflow execution.
